name: spn-core
description: SaaS Plane core, stack-agnostic: the DevEx stage skills (check, scm, ideate, plan, develop, test, provision, deliver, operate, report) — including ideate, the interactive loop that decides a boundary and shape into the repo-root CONCEPT.md before anything is planned; the SPN engineer persona; the spn-panel reviewer and the lens files it convenes (lead, business, product, architect, server-dev, web-dev, qa, infra, trust, partner, voice); contract review rules; the command vocabulary; the doc-set rules every node's docs are built to; the cross-repo working protocol; the getting-started digest; the new-platform intake worksheet; a hook that denies hand-edits to generated files; and a hook that checks every document — seats, READMEs, the concept, the artifacts — against the bars the book states mechanically: audience in the masthead, the Terms bound, no cardinality in prose, and the one voice measured (around fifteen words a sentence, you present; RD.DOCS.043).
